summary.text: Scot C. Heckert is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 13, listed with Wood County. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Public Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Heckert also serves on the House's Health and Human Resources, Homeland Security, Human Services and Judiciary committees.
